'''Miduis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she resided on the [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Miduis was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as Republic-side vendor for Galactic Command system.<ref name="SWTOR" />
